events.verdict: Horford (BOS) establishes himself in a screening position in McDaniels' (MIN) path and absorbs the contact.
Tatum (BOS) places both hands on Gobert (MIN) as he sets the screen but the contact is marginal.
Edwards (MIN) cleanly deflects the ball from White (BOS) in transition.
White (BOS) avoids stepping out of bounds while in possession of the ball.
McDaniels (MIN) contests Brown's (BOS) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Randle (MIN) releases the inbounds pass within five seconds.
Brown (BOS) initiates contact to Randle's (MIN) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
DiVincenzo (MIN) extends his arm slightly as White (BOS) dribbles near midcourt and the contact is marginal.
Tatum (BOS) attempts to drive in-between McDaniels (MIN) and Gobert (MIN) and any contact between the players is marginal.
Tatum (BOS) and Gobert (MIN) inadvertently get their legs tangled as they return to the floor.
DiVincenzo (MIN) legally contests Horford's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Horford (BOS) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Randle's (MIN) layup attempt.
Gobert (MIN) briefly grasps Brown's (BOS) off-arm and the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Edwards (MIN) has a hand placed on Holiday's (BOS) shoulder but he immediately removes it as both players pursue the rebound.
Brown (BOS) maintains a legal guarding position during Edwards' (MIN) drive to the basket.
